title: tc-segmented-control
description: Switch between two to six options, with a sliding indicator.

options.description: The options to switch between, in order – two to six read best

value.description: The picked value; unset picks the first enabled option. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

size.description: Height and text size of the control: "sm", "md" or "lg"

variant.description: "tray", "underline" or "buttons" (Clean only – Standard shows it as "tray"). Unset: "tray" in Standard, "buttons" in Clean

fullWidth.description: Fill the container with equal segments

kind.description: "radio" (a radiogroup, the default) or "tabs" (a tablist that switches panels)

disabled.description: Turns every option off; the hidden form input is disabled too

name.description: Submits the picked value with a native form, through a hidden input

form.description: The id of the form the hidden input belongs to, when the control sits outside it

count.description: A small gray number after the label, e.g. unread items

badge.description: A small tinted tag after the label, e.g. "Save 20%" – text, or an element (cloned)

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name – needed when the option only shows an icon

controls.description: With kind="tabs": the id of the panel this tab shows
